query: INSERT INTO migration_sources(image_id,category_id,original_hash,photo_id,taken_at,taken_at_local,gps_lat,gps_lon,generation) SELECT $1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7,$8,generation FROM photos WHERE id=$4 ON CONFLICT(image_id,category_id) DO UPDATE SET original_hash=excluded.original_hash,taken_at=excluded.taken_at,taken_at_local=excluded.taken_at_local,gps_lat=excluded.gps_lat,gps_lon=excluded.gps_lon,generation=excluded.generation,metadata_edited=false
